stories.headline: Sweden Democrats Break Riksdag Vote-Pairing Agreement, Triggering Constitutional Crisis
stories.summary: Sweden Democrats broke the informal kvittning (vote-pairing) convention during a citizenship vote on approximately April 29, allowing their bloc to narrowly win while Åkesson himself was absent. Opposition and even Moderaterna condemned the move as a breach of parliamentary norms, the pairing system collapsed, and all members are now required to attend votes in person.

stories.headline: Aurora 26 Military Exercise Underway with 18,000 Participants Including Ukrainian Drone Unit

A Ukrainian 'Red Team' drone unit is training Swedish forces in drone warfare, and a military truck struck a rail viaduct in Eldsberga during exercise movements.

stories.headline: Swedish Armed Forces Launches First Operational Military Surveillance Satellite
stories.summary: Sweden's first operational military reconnaissance and surveillance satellite was launched via SpaceX from California on May 3, marking Sweden's entry into active space-domain operations. Försvarsmakten plans to field approximately ten satellites over the coming two years for long-range targeting and area surveillance.

stories.headline: Riksbank Rate Decision Due May 6-7; Analysts Unanimously Expect Hold at 1.75%
stories.summary: Sweden's Riksbank is scheduled to announce its interest rate decision on May 6-7. All polled analysts expect the rate to remain unchanged at 1.75%, as Swedish core inflation came in at 1.1% in March—well below the 2% target—though the ongoing Middle East war and energy price volatility complicate the outlook. Governor Thedéen has flagged Sweden's limited oil dependency.

stories.headline: Sweden Drops 'Islamophobia' Terminology, Pushes EU and UN to Follow
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Malmer Stenergard announced during a Riksdag debate on approximately April 24 that Sweden will no longer use the term 'Islamophobia,' calling it 'problematic' for conflating irrational fear with legitimate religious criticism. Sweden is pushing EU and UN bodies to adopt the replacement term 'anti-Muslim hatred' or 'anti-Muslim racism.'
